title: #2890 round 1 — the shared worker client: «הציגו תצורה אחרת» waits its turn, 2-D's worker starts with the page (PR, port 5174)

cases.title: 2-D: «הציגו תצורה אחרת» pressed while a slow line is still computing is not lost
cases.lookFor: Type the first two lines. Type the third and press Enter; while «הוסף» still reads «חושב…» (about 5 seconds), press «הציגו תצורה אחרת». When the line lands, the figure then changes once more by itself, to another configuration.
cases.before: On prod the press does nothing: the figure stays the line's own.

cases.title: 2-D: the defining interaction builds exactly as before
cases.lookFor: The square, G on AD, the 37° angle at B; three green rows.

cases.title: 2-D: «הציגו תצורה אחרת» on its own still changes the figure
cases.lookFor: Each press moves the right angle to another vertex.

cases.title: 2-D: a contradicting length is still refused
cases.lookFor: The third line is refused: «… סותר את «AB = 5» …»; two rows.

cases.title: 2-D: deleting a row and «בטל»
cases.lookFor: The third row goes and comes back; three rows.

cases.title: 3-D: the slow figure, a row off and on, and «הציגו תצורה אחרת»
cases.lookFor: Three rows at the end, S with SA = 5; the press redraws.

cases.title: 3-D: a cube with a midpoint builds as before

cases.title: 3-D: a wrong claim is still refused
cases.lookFor: «הטענה לא מתקיימת בציור — בדקו את החישוב»; one row.

cases.title: Analytic: an ordinary figure, «בטל» and «בצע שוב»

cases.lookFor: «לא נמצאה תצורה שבה מתקיים: «AB = 7»»; three rows.
